WITH d AS (
    SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) AS full_date 
    FROM generate_series(DATE '2016-01-01', DATE '2020-12-31', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(x)
),
holiday AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES
            (DATE '2016-02-09'),(DATE '2016-03-25'),(DATE '2017-02-28'),(DATE '2017-04-14'),
            (DATE '2018-02-13'),(DATE '2018-03-30'),(DATE '2019-03-05'),(DATE '2019-04-19'),
            (DATE '2020-02-25'),(DATE '2020-04-10')
    ) v(h)
)
SELECT 
    
CAST(strftime(full_date, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER)
 AS date_key, 
    full_date,
    year(full_date) AS year, 
    quarter(full_date) AS quarter, 
    month(full_date) AS month,
    strftime(full_date, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, 
    weekofyear(full_date) AS week,
    isodow(full_date) AS day_of_week, 
    isodow(full_date) >= 6 AS is_weekend,
    strftime(full_date, '%m-%d') IN ('01-01','04-21','05-01','09-07','10-12','11-02','11-15','12-25')
        OR full_date IN (SELECT h FROM holiday) AS is_holiday_br,
    full_date IN (DATE '2016-11-25', DATE '2017-11-24', DATE '2018-11-23', DATE '2019-11-29', DATE '2020-11-27') AS is_black_friday
FROM d

SELECT

    stage, 
    is_delivered, 
    is_canceled
FROM (

        ('invoiced', 3, FALSE, FALSE), 
        ('processing', 4, FALSE, FALSE),
        ('shipped', 5, FALSE, FALSE), 
        ('delivered', 6, TRUE, FALSE), 
        ('canceled', 7, FALSE, TRUE), 
        ('unavailable', 8, FALSE, TRUE)
) v(status, stage, is_delivered, is_canceled)

WITH geo AS (
    SELECT
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_prefix,
        TRY_CAST(geolocation_lat AS DOUBLE) AS lat,
        TRY_CAST(geolocation_lng AS DOUBLE) AS lng,
        
CASE 
    WHEN trim(regexp_replace(trim(regexp_split_to_array(lower(strip_accents(regexp_replace(trim(replace(geolocation_city, '´', '''')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))), '\s*[/\\,]\s*|\s+-\s+')[1]), '[\s-](ac|al|am|ap|ba|ce|df|es|go|ma|mg|ms|mt|pa|pb|pe|pi|pr|rj|rn|ro|rr|rs|sc|se|sp|to)$', '')) IS NULL 
      OR trim(regexp_replace(trim(regexp_split_to_array(lower(strip_accents(regexp_replace(trim(replace(geolocation_city, '´', '''')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))), '\s*[/\\,]\s*|\s+-\s+')[1]), '[\s-](ac|al|am|ap|ba|ce|df|es|go|ma|mg|ms|mt|pa|pb|pe|pi|pr|rj|rn|ro|rr|rs|sc|se|sp|to)$', '')) = '' 
      OR regexp_matches(trim(regexp_replace(trim(regexp_split_to_array(lower(strip_accents(regexp_replace(trim(replace(geolocation_city, '´', '''')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))), '\s*[/\\,]\s*|\s+-\s+')[1]), '[\s-](ac|al|am|ap|ba|ce|df|es|go|ma|mg|ms|mt|pa|pb|pe|pi|pr|rj|rn|ro|rr|rs|sc|se|sp|to)$', '')), '[0-9@]') 
    THEN NULL 
    ELSE trim(regexp_replace(trim(regexp_split_to_array(lower(strip_accents(regexp_replace(trim(replace(geolocation_city, '´', '''')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))), '\s*[/\\,]\s*|\s+-\s+')[1]), '[\s-](ac|al|am|ap|ba|ce|df|es|go|ma|mg|ms|mt|pa|pb|pe|pi|pr|rj|rn|ro|rr|rs|sc|se|sp|to)$', '')) 
END
 AS city,
        upper(trim(geolocation_state)) AS state
    FROM "olist"."raw"."geolocation"
)
SELECT
    zip_prefix,
    median(lat) FILTER (WHERE lat BETWEEN -34 AND 6 AND lng BETWEEN -74 AND -34) AS lat,
    median(lng) FILTER (WHERE lat BETWEEN -34 AND 6 AND lng BETWEEN -74 AND -34) AS lng,
    mode(city) AS city,
    mode(state) AS state
FROM geo
GROUP BY zip_prefix

SELECT
    order_id,

FROM "olist"."raw"."order_items"
WHERE TRY_CAST(price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) > 0

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts,
        TRY_CAST(order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_ts,
        TRY_CAST(order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS carrier_ts,
        TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS delivered_ts,
        TRY_CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS estimated_ts,
        min(dwh_batch) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS first_batch,
        max(dwh_batch) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS last_batch,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS n_versions,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY dwh_batch DESC) AS rn
    FROM "olist"."raw"."orders"
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    purchase_ts,
    approved_ts,
    carrier_ts,
    delivered_ts,
    estimated_ts,
    first_batch,
    last_batch,
    n_versions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT

    CAST(payment_installments AS INTEGER) AS payment_installments,
    CAST(payment_value AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS payment_value,

FROM "olist"."raw"."order_payments"
WHERE TRY_CAST(payment_value AS DECIMAL(12,2)) >= 0

WITH z AS (
    SELECT zip_prefix FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_geography"
    UNION SELECT zip_prefix FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_customers"
    UNION SELECT zip_prefix FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_sellers"
),
c AS (SELECT zip_prefix, mode(city) AS city, mode(state) AS state FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_customers" GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT zip_prefix, mode(city) AS city, mode(state) AS state FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_sellers" GROUP BY 1)
SELECT -1 AS location_key, 'UNKNOWN' AS zip_prefix, 'khong ro' AS city, NULL AS state, 'Khong ro' AS region,
       NULL::DOUBLE AS lat, NULL::DOUBLE AS lng, FALSE AS has_coordinates
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY z.zip_prefix) AS location_key, 
    z.zip_prefix,
    coalesce(g.city, c.city, s.city, 'khong ro') AS city, 
    coalesce(g.state, c.state, s.state) AS state,
    
CASE
    WHEN coalesce(g.state, c.state, s.state) IN ('AC','AM','AP','PA','RO','RR','TO') THEN 'Norte'
    WHEN coalesce(g.state, c.state, s.state) IN ('AL','BA','CE','MA','PB','PE','PI','RN','SE') THEN 'Nordeste'
    WHEN coalesce(g.state, c.state, s.state) IN ('DF','GO','MS','MT') THEN 'Centro-Oeste'
    WHEN coalesce(g.state, c.state, s.state) IN ('ES','MG','RJ','SP') THEN 'Sudeste'
    WHEN coalesce(g.state, c.state, s.state) IN ('PR','RS','SC') THEN 'Sul'
    ELSE 'Khong ro'
END
 AS region, 
    g.lat, 
    g.lng, 
    g.lat IS NOT NULL AS has_coordinates
FROM z 
LEFT JOIN "olist"."stg"."stg_geography" g USING (zip_prefix) 
LEFT JOIN c USING (zip_prefix) 
LEFT JOIN s USING (zip_prefix)

SELECT -1 AS seller_key, 'UNKNOWN' AS seller_id, NULL AS zip_prefix, 'khong ro' AS city, NULL AS state, 'Khong ro' AS region,
       'Khong ro' AS health_tier, TIMESTAMP '2016-01-01' AS valid_from, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31' AS valid_to, TRUE AS is_current
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY seller_id) AS seller_key, 
    seller_id, 
    zip_prefix, 
    city, 
    state, 
    
CASE
    WHEN state IN ('AC','AM','AP','PA','RO','RR','TO') THEN 'Norte'
    WHEN state IN ('AL','BA','CE','MA','PB','PE','PI','RN','SE') THEN 'Nordeste'
    WHEN state IN ('DF','GO','MS','MT') THEN 'Centro-Oeste'
    WHEN state IN ('ES','MG','RJ','SP') THEN 'Sudeste'
    WHEN state IN ('PR','RS','SC') THEN 'Sul'
    ELSE 'Khong ro'
END
 AS region,
    'Chưa hoạt động' AS health_tier, 
    TIMESTAMP '2016-01-01' AS valid_from, 
    TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31' AS valid_to, 
    TRUE AS is_current
FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_sellers"

SELECT 
    pm.order_id, 
    pm.payment_sequential, 
    pm.payment_type, 
    pm.payment_installments, 
    pm.payment_value,
    coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) AS customer_key, 
    
CAST(strftime(o.purchase_ts, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER)
 AS purchase_date_key, 
    pm.dwh_batch
FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_payments" pm
JOIN "olist"."stg"."stg_orders" o USING (order_id)
LEFT JOIN "olist"."stg"."stg_customers" c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN "olist"."core"."dim_customer" dc ON dc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id

SELECT 
    r.review_id, 
    r.order_id, 
    coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) AS customer_key,
    
CAST(strftime(r.created_ts, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER)
 AS created_date_key, 
    
CAST(strftime(r.review_ts, '%Y%m%d') AS INTEGER)
 AS answered_date_key, 
    r.created_ts, 
    r.review_ts AS answered_ts,
    r.review_score, 
    r.has_title, 
    r.has_comment,
    date_sub('second', r.created_ts, r.review_ts) / 3600.0 AS answer_hours,
    CAST(o.delivered_ts AS DATE) > CAST(o.estimated_ts AS DATE) AS customer_late,
    o.delivered_ts IS NULL OR r.review_ts < o.delivered_ts AS is_before_delivery,
    r.dwh_batch
FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_reviews" r
JOIN "olist"."stg"."stg_orders" o USING (order_id)
LEFT JOIN "olist"."stg"."stg_customers" c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN "olist"."core"."dim_customer" dc ON dc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id

WITH c AS (
    SELECT state, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lng) AS lng 
    FROM "olist"."core"."dim_location" 
    WHERE has_coordinates 
    GROUP BY state
),
ss AS (SELECT DISTINCT state FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_sellers" WHERE state IS NOT NULL),
cs AS (SELECT DISTINCT state FROM "olist"."stg"."stg_customers" WHERE state IS NOT NULL)
SELECT -1 AS route_key, NULL AS seller_state, NULL AS customer_state, NULL AS route_name, NULL::BOOLEAN AS same_state, NULL::DOUBLE AS distance_km
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ss.state, cs.state) AS route_key, 
    ss.state, 
    cs.state, 
    ss.state || '->' || cs.state AS route_name, 
    ss.state = cs.state AS same_state,
    2 * 6371 * asin(sqrt(pow(sin(radians(c2.lat - c1.lat) / 2), 2)
        + cos(radians(c1.lat)) * cos(radians(c2.lat)) * pow(sin(radians(c2.lng - c1.lng) / 2), 2))) AS distance_km
FROM ss 
CROSS JOIN cs
LEFT JOIN c c1 ON c1.state = ss.state
LEFT JOIN c c2 ON c2.state = cs.state

WITH latest_cutoff AS (
    SELECT coalesce(max(purchase_ts), TIMESTAMP '2018-09-03') AS c
    FROM "olist"."core"."fact_sales_item"
),
_w AS (
    SELECT 
        i.seller_id, 
        i.order_id, 
        i.purchase_ts AS ts, 
        CAST(i.price AS DOUBLE) AS price, 
        i.shipping_limit_ts AS lim,
        p.category_en, 
        ds.region, 
        f.carrier_ts, 
        f.delivered_ts, 
        f.estimated_ts, 
        f.review_score, 
        f.first_review_ts,
        f.days_in_transit, 
        i.is_valid_sale
    FROM "olist"."core"."fact_sales_item" i
    JOIN "olist"."core"."dim_product" p USING (product_key)
    JOIN "olist"."core"."dim_seller" ds ON ds.seller_key = i.seller_key
    JOIN "olist"."core"."fact_order_seller" f ON f.order_id = i.order_id AND f.seller_id = i.seller_id
),
h AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id, 
        max(ts) AS last_ts, 
        min(ts) AS first_ts 
    FROM _w 
    WHERE is_valid_sale 
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
w AS (
    SELECT w0.* 
    FROM _w w0
    CROSS JOIN latest_cutoff lc
    WHERE w0.is_valid_sale AND w0.ts >= lc.c - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
late_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id, 
        order_id, 
        bool_or(carrier_ts IS NOT NULL AND carrier_ts <= lim) AS seller_ok
    FROM w
    CROSS JOIN latest_cutoff lc
    WHERE estimated_ts < lc.c
      AND (delivered_ts IS NULL OR CAST(delivered_ts AS DATE) > CAST(estimated_ts AS DATE))
    GROUP BY seller_id, order_id
),
lo AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id, 
        count(*) AS n_late, 
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE seller_ok) AS n_ok 
    FROM late_orders 
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
a AS (
    SELECT 
        w.seller_id,
        sum(w.price) AS gmv_90, 
        count(DISTINCT w.order_id) AS orders_90,
        coalesce(sum(w.price) FILTER (WHERE w.ts >= lc.c - INTERVAL 30 DAY), 0) AS gmv_30,
        count(DISTINCT w.order_id) FILTER (WHERE w.ts >= lc.c - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS orders_30,
        count(DISTINCT w.category_en) AS n_cat,
        avg(CASE WHEN w.carrier_ts IS NULL OR w.carrier_ts > w.lim THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE w.lim < lc.c) AS seller_late_rate,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.lim < lc.c) AS n_limit_known,
        avg(CASE WHEN w.delivered_ts IS NULL OR CAST(w.delivered_ts AS DATE) > CAST(w.estimated_ts AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
            FILTER (WHERE w.estimated_ts < lc.c) AS cust_late_rate,
        avg(w.review_score) FILTER (WHERE w.first_review_ts < lc.c) AS avg_review,
        avg(date_sub('second', w.ts, w.carrier_ts) / 86400.0) FILTER (WHERE w.carrier_ts < lc.c) AS days_to_carrier
    FROM w
    CROSS JOIN latest_cutoff lc
    GROUP BY w.seller_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(lc.c AS DATE) AS as_of, 
        a.seller_id, 
        a.gmv_90, 
        a.orders_90, 
        a.gmv_30, 
        a.orders_30,
        a.gmv_30 / nullif(a.gmv_90 / 3, 0) - 1 AS trend,
        date_sub('second', h.last_ts, lc.c) / 86400.0 AS recency,
        date_sub('second', h.first_ts, lc.c) / 86400.0 AS tenure,
        a.n_cat, 
        a.seller_late_rate, 
        a.cust_late_rate, 
        a.avg_review, 
        a.days_to_carrier, 
        a.n_limit_known,
        coalesce(lo.n_late, 0) AS n_cust_late_orders, 
        coalesce(lo.n_ok, 0) AS n_cust_late_seller_ok
    FROM a 
    CROSS JOIN latest_cutoff lc
    JOIN h USING (seller_id) 
    LEFT JOIN lo USING (seller_id)
)
SELECT 
    s.*,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.recency > 45 THEN 'Tạm ngừng'
        WHEN s.orders_90 < 6 THEN 'Ít đơn'
        WHEN (s.trend < -0.5 AND s.recency > 21) OR (s.seller_late_rate >= 0.30 AND s.n_limit_known >= 5) THEN 'Nguy cơ'
        WHEN s.trend < -0.40 OR (s.seller_late_rate >= 0.15 AND s.n_limit_known >= 5) OR s.avg_review < 3.5 THEN 'Theo dõi'
        WHEN s.gmv_90 >= quantile_cont(s.gmv_90, 0.8) OVER () THEN 'Vàng'
        ELSE 'Ổn định' 
    END AS health_tier
FROM scored s

        avg(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL OR CAST(delivered_ts AS DATE) > CAST(estimated_ts AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS customer_late_rate,
        avg(review_score) AS avg_review,

    FROM _w

),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        m.*,
        avg(m.gmv) OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.seller_id 
            ORDER BY m.month 
            ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS gmv_prev_3m_avg,
        cur.seller_key
    FROM monthly m
    JOIN "olist"."core"."dim_seller" cur ON cur.seller_id = m.seller_id AND cur.is_current
)

    AND h.review_band = CASE WHEN p.avg_review IS NULL THEN 'Chưa rõ' WHEN p.avg_review < 3.5 THEN 'Dưới 3,5' WHEN p.avg_review <= 4.2 THEN '3,5-4,2' ELSE 'Trên 4,2' END
